name: connection-end-ends-page-request
description: A request that the page holds has no time limit and ends by its reply while its connection is open; the end of its connection ends it on the host, and the later reply of the page is an observation.
reason: The page of the case is a script that the host producers play; a running application has a page of its own that answers differently.

log.line: info host endpoint: reply to 1 not sent: peer closed
info host exposure: exposure reply 2 arrived after its request ended
